title: Eleceed Anime First Trailer Introduces Main Voice Cast
content: The upcoming ELECEED anime has revealed the first trailer and main voice cast ahead of show’s early 2027 release. It was originally planned to release this year . The anime is being produced by studio DandeLion Animation Studio, known for its work on THE FIRST SLAM DUNK and the short film Magic Candies .
author: Anime Corner

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, June 15-21
content: Sunao Katabuchi and Madhouse 's Mai Mai Miracle anime film aired on NHK Educational on Saturday, June 20 at 3:25 p.m. and earned a 0.6% rating. The television ratings above are an estimate of the percentage of the population that watch a given program, based on data from a survey of households in Japan's Kanto region.
author: ANN

title: Every Super Saiyan 3 Transformation in Dragon Ball, Ranked
content: Dragon Ball emerged as the first prominent shonen series to fully embody the concept of character transformations. Essentially, these forms are visual representations of a character’s growth, mostly depicted through changes in hairstyle and the energy they emit.
author: ComicBook

title: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc Introduces Oni Brigade Cast with New Key Visual
content: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc sequel anime revealed a new key visual and 8 Oni Brigade voice cast members ahead of the anime’s October 2026 release. The sequel was officially announced after Season 1’s final Episode 24.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Arrives to Netflix Worldwide on July 22
content: Netflix will officially begin streaming JUJUTSU KAISEN: The Culling Game Part 1 (Season 3) worldwide on July 22. The first part of the arc aired in Winter 2026 in Japan, with Crunchyroll simulcasting it globally. Part 2, The Culling Game Part 2 (Season 4) is currently in production .
author: Anime Corner

title: 20th Anniversary Sgt. Frog Film Opens at #4, 2026 Anpanman Film at #5
content: Kiyoshi Kurosawa 's live-action film adaptation of Honobu Yonezawa 's The Samurai and the Prisoner ( Kokurōjō ) samurai historical mystery novel dropped from #2 to #3 in its second weekend. The film sold 108,000 tickets and earned 151,785,820 yen (about US$933,800) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Monogatari Reveals Visual and Release Date for Wazamonogatari: Karen Ogre New Episode
content: Monogatari Series: Off & Monster Season anime is officially continuing with a brand new episode Wazamonogatari: Karen Ogre . The episode is set to premiere next winter. The new installment will focus on Karen Araragi, who is now a first-year high school student.
author: Anime Corner

title: Monogatari Off & Monster Season Anime's New Episode Debuts in Winter
content: Aniplex revealed a new visual and the winter 2026 broadcast for the upcoming " Wazamonogatari : Karen Ogre" episode of the MONOGATARI Series: OFF & MONSTER Season anime on Thursday. Franchise veteran Akiyuki Simbo is again serving as chief director and Midori Yoshizawa is directing the new episode at SHAFT .
author: ANN
